title: It took a year to ship WebAssembly in Anubis
summary: A detailed technical retrospective on the year-long journey of integrating WebAssembly into Anubis, a developer tool/platform, sharing the real-world challenges, architectural decisions, and lessons learned from shipping WASM support in a production system.
problem_solved: Successfully integrated WebAssembly runtime support into the Anubis platform, enabling users to run WASM-compiled code within the existing infrastructure.
why_valuable: Provides authentic, hard-won insights from a year of production WASM integration that can help other developers avoid similar pitfalls and set realistic expectations for their own WASM adoption journeys.
